kind: Project material revisit comparison: frozen single-history and new multi-history models
tie_choice: Uniform choice over early/late, expected and worst regret under reference peak compression; reporting convention, not deployed policy
outcome: Positive peak max(0,-epsilon_11) during common reload probe, minimized
recovery_metrics: Zero-stress delay after the common candidate window; include both interval endpoints

protocol.purpose: Bounded material transfer after R2 original-method results; not a completed experiment or robot-control claim
protocol.reference_protocol: Same 3D nonlinear reference material and interpretation as r2-rnn.json
protocol.initial_state: independently initialized virgin equilibrium for each complete history

boundary.free_recovery: zero external stress with strain and internal state solved; never clamp strain to zero

protocol.interpolation: piecewise_linear stress commands; times below are local to each phase
protocol.candidate_comparison: same 1 s window, peak stress and absolute stress-time integral (2.4 MPa*s); only timing differs
protocol.recovery_delay_note: Fixed project delays after the common candidate window; not a constant material tau. Assess reference recovery from the actual response without selecting favorable learned-model results.
state_rules: run the full observable prefix separately in each model
branch from each model's own physically reached state

metrics.rank_score: peak max(0,-epsilon_11) during common reload probe; smaller means less future compression, not full robot utility

protocol.protocol_provenance: Project transfer experiment, not an original TM02 figure or SuperMimic reproduction. Freeze before evaluation; no evaluation-based path or parameter selection.

numerics.integration: implicit Euler, Newton-Raphson with residual-merit backtracking; no time subdivision or alternate solver
numerics.shear_convention: tensor components; tensor gradients divide shear derivatives by 2

scope: All six reference pairs favor early. Agreement with them cannot demonstrate history-dependent action selection or robot-control benefit; compare always-early regret explicitly.

artifact_package.archive_index_snapshot: Both compact indexes are included before adding this archive SHA256 and byte count. The external checksum sidecar authenticates the archive; its internal file manifest authenticates the included index snapshots and other files.
